items.q: Does using my card require an app?
items.a: No. The person receiving your card has nothing to install: your profile opens directly in their browser when tapping the card on their phone, or by scanning the QR code.

items.q: Is the card compatible with all phones?
items.a: NFC works on nearly all recent smartphones (iOS and Android). For the rare devices without active NFC, the QR code on the back opens the same profile.

items.q: Can I edit my information after purchase?
items.a: Yes, as many times as you like. Your profile updates in real time, without ever reprogramming the physical card.

items.q: What happens if I lose my card?
items.a: You can suspend the card from your dashboard to disable sharing, then replace it without losing your profile.
No personal data is stored in the chip: it only holds a short link to your profile, which you fully control.
Depending on the model, expect 2 to 7 business days. Prestige cards ship express.
